claims.claim: ESA has selected the Plasma Observatory mission, which will use seven coordinated spacecraft to measure solar energy flow through Earth’s magnetic shield.
claims.episode_span: The mission will fly seven coordinated spacecraft. They will measure how solar energy flows through Earth’s magnetic shield at multiple scales of distance and time.
claims.source_title: ESA science missions get green light for new discoveries
claims.supporting_quote: Plasma Observatory has been selected as our next medium-class space science mission. Its seven coordinated spacecraft will track how the Sun’s energy moves through Earth’s magnetic shield, across different scales of distance and time.

claims.claim: Aldebaran appears aligned with the Hyades cluster but lies at a different distance and moves independently of its stars.
claims.episode_span: Aldebaran appears to the eye as the brightest member of the Hyades but lies at a different distance. Its proper motion and parallax measurements show it is unrelated to the cluster’s stars.
claims.source_title: There's an impostor hiding in the Hyades star cluster. Can you spot it?
claims.supporting_quote: Aldebaran looks for all the world like the brightest member of the Hyades star cluster. It isn't — and discovering why changes the way you look at constellations.
